rule: fit only on even training cameras; odd cameras independently validate. All-frame tiles including partial borders. Tile valid only if every RGB sample finite and in0..1. Candidate centers are occupied 1/32 grid-bin centers; winner maximizes area-weighted low-texture median support within L-infinity radius12/255; fixed deterministic lexicographic tie break. Refine once to coordinate-wise weighted median. No thresholds adjusted after results.
noHeldout: Exclude midpoint internal holdout8 as well as never decode external benchmark holdouts. No heldout images enter estimates.
